name: Scale-up Worker visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a confirmed job offer from an approved scale-up business — either endorsed by an approved body, or one that grew at least 20%/year in employment or turnover over 3 years with 10+ employees at the start of that period. Sponsorship is only required for the first 6 months of the visa.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a qualifying scale-up sponsor.

value.note: or the occupation-specific going rate, whichever is higher

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a salary of at least £39,100/year, or the going rate for the occupation code, whichever is higher, in a role at RQF Level 6 or above.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary or confirm the applicable going rate for the occupation code.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires English at CEFR B2 for new applicants from 8 January 2026 (B1 is retained only for those extending who held the visa before that date).
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at B2.

evidence_required.document: Approved English test certificate at B2
Bank statement showing at least £1,270 held for 28 days (unless exempt)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years (outside UK) / up to 3 years (in-country), extendable

sources.title: Scale-up Worker visa: Your job - GOV.UK

notes: Fee £937 confirmed via gov.uk 'how much it costs' page; a cached-looking £880 figure appears on some secondary sources — flagged as stale. Structurally distinct from every other work_sponsored route in this dataset: sponsorship is only required for the FIRST 6 MONTHS, after which the holder is fully unsponsored and can change jobs or become self-employed freely for the remainder of the visa. This does not fit cleanly into the current schema's single job_offer_status requirement, which implies sponsorship for the full duration — a real modeling gap worth flagging alongside the other known gaps (Outcome/prerequisites bound to Route not RequirementGroup). Dependant rules are NOT restricted the way Skilled Worker's July 2025 RQF-6 changes restricted dependants on some codes — Scale-up dependants can join without that constraint, a genuine differentiator worth surfacing in the 'by outcome' browse view once built.
